title: Welcome screen — buddy and text lined up

steps.path: The buddy and heading on the first screen after setup (close-up at your 1.5x scale)
steps.headline: The whole buddy, head to feet, is now centred on the heading and line beside it.
steps.changed: The buddy's box centred its body, but its feet hang below, so the figure sat about 13px lower than the text. It's lifted by that much.
steps.notice: The top of the buddy's head and the heading start at nearly the same height, and its feet end level with the line under the heading.
